main_measure.name: OLS slope of next-day return minus coin mean daily return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject if slope < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2: the higher the close, the larger the next-day fall.
reading: The agitated profile is read as regime 'unknown' (not 'chop'); the slope is an OLS slope with intercept on all profile bars with a non-zero forecast and a next bar in the same window, its t day-clustered (CR1); the plan's minimums (500 bars, 250 days) are applied as 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0003521 on the check folds against +0.001007 on every fold
